tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground. Text sits on it; never pure black or white in Dark and Dim.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels and inputs raised above `bg`; the Reader panel.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on `bg` and `surface`.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text (captions, helper text) on `bg` and `surface`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Borders of controls, inputs and cards; 3:1 or better on `bg` and `surface`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Links, primary buttons and selected states. Used as link text on `bg` and `surface`.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an `accent` fill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid with 2px offset; 3:1 on every ground.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icon on `bg` and `surface`; always paired with the word or a check mark.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icon on `bg` and `surface`; always paired with the word or a triangle.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text and icon on `bg` and `surface`; always paired with the word or a cross.

tokens.name: success-cvd
tokens.usage: Success text and icon in color-vision mode (blue, off the red-green axis); pair with the word or a check mark.

tokens.name: warning-cvd
tokens.usage: Warning text and icon in color-vision mode (Okabe-Ito orange, darkened for text); pair with the word or a triangle.

tokens.name: danger-cvd
tokens.usage: Error text and icon in color-vision mode (Okabe-Ito vermillion, darkened for text); pair with the word or a cross.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page title; type scale step 1.25 from 18px.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Reading text: 18px at line height 1.5. Dark themes raise weight to 450 in the Reader.
styles.sample: Reading is a skill we build once and use all day.

styles.name: body-serif
styles.usage: Long-form reading in the serif family.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Buttons, labels, form fields. 16px keeps weight at 400 or above.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Captions and helper text; use only with `ink` or stronger.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps, icon-to-label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inline gaps, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; minimum page gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between related groups.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section spacing.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Large section spacing.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page-level spacing.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum size of every interactive target.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, alerts, cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Reader panel, large cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Preset chips and theme swatches.

tokens.name: measure-min
tokens.usage: Narrowest allowed line length.

tokens.name: measure-default
tokens.usage: Default reading column.

tokens.name: measure-max
tokens.usage: Widest allowed line length; above 75ch line height becomes at least 1.6.

tokens.name: gap-item
tokens.usage: Between items inside one group: list rows, label to value.

tokens.name: gap-group
tokens.usage: Between groups; at least 2x gap-item, so spacing alone shows what belongs together.

tokens.name: gap-section
tokens.usage: Between sections; at least 1.5x gap-group.
